Esta política explica que dados o Finanç: This policy explains what data Finanças handles and why, in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
E-mail e nome da conta; os lançamentos,: Email and account name; the entries, bills, goals, comments and likes you create; and minimal technical data to sync (update dates).

No seu aparelho e na base de dados Supab: On your device and in the app's Supabase database. Invoices, photos and audio are processed on the phone itself and are not sent; only the result you confirm (name, amount, date) is stored.
